findings.note: DESK #158 (owner, 2026-09-12): "keep both, mark the old one legacy, add a 'remastered as …' link". The 181 records whose reprint already ships are now stamped `edition: 'legacy'` + `remasteredAs` by the chain (scripts/lib/reprint.mjs shippedTwin -> scripts/migration/build-map.mjs -> stamp-aonid.mjs), which runs AFTER the overlay is applied. Nine of those records still carried an older overlay row saying `legacy-era`, authored before the ruling existed. Both values are hidden by the same hide-legacy toggle, so nothing a player sees changes — but the row no longer describes the shipped artefact, and scripts/regen-durability-check.mjs is right to call that out: "14482 rows — 9 NOT baked … every one of those rows is authored and inert, and no other guard will say so". An inert row is the shape this project keeps finding late, and leaving nine of them as a known exception is how the check stops being read. So the rows are re-stated at the ruling's value: the overlay and the stamp now agree, the bake check goes green, and replaying the overlay alone (scripts/apply-backfill-now.mjs) can no longer put the pair out of step. Seven are the Rune of Sin family, whose reprint ships as items/rune-of-sin; the other two are the `aon-` scrape twins of Fulu of Concealment and Master Summoner Spellcasting.
